comparison.objective: Partition five weighted parcels between two totes without exceeding either 7 kg limit.
comparison.physical_skill: Weight-based allocation and bimanual parcel transport.
comparison.success_condition: All parcels are split into two valid 7 kg loads; an overweight tote fails.
comparison.reason: The essential ability is combinatorial load balancing, not tool alignment, controlled impact, fracture, or debris recovery.
